texto:
We can hop.
We can run.
We can all play.
Play is fun.

I see a pal.
My pal can sit.
I sit by my pal.
We grin.

Sam has a ball.
I wait my turn.
Sam rolls the ball.
Now it is my turn.

I see a drum.
Tap, tap, tap!
We clap and tap.
We make a beat.

My mom can hum.
My dad can hum.
We sing at home.
Hum, hum, hum!

I see red.
I see blue.
I make flag art.
I show it to you.

I see sand.
I see a can.
I pick up the can.
The sand is clean.

I see a seed.
I put it in dirt.
I add some water.
A plant pops up.

I see the sea.
I see a fish.
I keep the sea clean.
Swim, fish, swim!

I have a box.
I make a boat.
The boat can float.
Go, boat, go!

My box has no lid.
I find a lid.
I put it on.
I can fix it!

I have a cup.
I add one cup.
The cups go up.
My tower is tall!

I wash my hands.
I rub and rub.
I rinse my hands.
My hands are clean.

I can hop.
I can skip.
I can run.
I can rest.

I see an apple.
The apple is red.
I wash the apple.
I take a bite.

I play all day.
I put toys away.
I get in bed.
I rest my head.

I see a tablet.
I tap a letter.
I say its sound.
I put it away.

I see a phone.
I want a photo.
I ask my pal first.
My pal says yes.

I see a star.
I see it on a screen.
I look up at night.
I see a real star!

I tap the screen.
I see a cat.
I stop and rest.
I go play.
